subject: Pilot credits contingent on usage milestones - LumosAI
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@lumosai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@lumosai.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Request: Pilot credits tied to usage milestones

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked great for our inference paths. We discussed pilot credits on the call and I wanted to follow up with a concrete ask. LumosAI is preparing a 6-week pilot (MVP) and we are hopeful Redwood can provide a promotional credit that helps cover the expected GPU usage.

We can commit to the following if Redwood will offer credits up front:
- Reach 500 committed API calls/week by week 3
- Provide engineering feedback via a weekly 30-min sync
- Convert to a paid plan if sustained throughput of 1k calls/week is met by end of pilot

Attached is a high-level cost estimate for our MVP and an outline of the milestones. Can Redwood do a conditional credit of $8k (applied to invoices) that vests in two tranches once the week-3 and week-6 milestones are validated?

[Attachment: lumos_mvp_costs.xlsx (xlsx)]

Happy to hop on a short call to nail timing.

Best,
Elena Torres
Head of Product, LumosAI
elena@lumosai.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: Elena Torres <elena@lumosai.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 11:36:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credits tied to usage milestones

Elena —

Really appreciate the clear milestones. We can support a conditional pilot credit, happy to propose a structure that protects both sides operationally. High level proposal:

- Total promotional credit: $8,000 applied as account credit against Redwood usage.
- Tranche 1 ($4,000) released after verification of week-3 milestone: >=500 committed API calls in a rolling 7-day window and active integration (logs showing KV cache usage).
- Tranche 2 ($4,000) released after week-6 milestone: >=1,000 calls/week sustained and a short post-pilot feedback session.
- Verification: engineering validates via shared dashboard access + Redwood support engineer confirms metrics.
- Eligibility: customer must complete a security checklist (SSO + IP allowlist OR SOC 2 review summary) before tranche 1 is issued.

Practical asks on our side:
1) Please sign a short credit amendment that attaches to the Master Subscription Agreement — I can route a DocuSign.
2) Provide the HubSpot deal id and a point of contact for the technical validation (we can CC them into the metric dashboard).

Jordan — can you confirm that Solutions Eng can profile the expected call shape and set up a shared metric view? Marissa — is finance OK with the conditional credit holdback and typical 90-day expiration on unused credits?

If this is acceptable, I’ll draft the amendment and the milestone verification checklist.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
[Attachment: usage-milestones-draft.pdf (pdf)]
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Elena Torres <elena@lumosai.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 08:19:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credits tied to usage milestones

Rishi / Elena —

I looked at the lumos_mvp_costs.xlsx you sent. The call distribution looks bursty (peak at short sequences), which maps well to a single-GPU pool with prefix caching. I can stand up a read-only dashboard (Grafana link) that shows request counts, tail latency, and KV cache hit-rate.

Couple of notes:
- For tranche verification we should tie to both request count AND a cache hit-rate threshold (>=20%) to ensure the workload is actually using the runtime optimizations.
- I’ll add a tiny instrumentation file (agent) that Lumos engineering can include — it reports only aggregated counts and latency slices (no payloads).

I’ll prepare the dashboard and send an invite to Elena + Raj. Planning to have the dashboard ready by Monday (26 Apr).

—Jordan
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Torres <elena@lumosai.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Raj Patel <raj@lumosai.com>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: Pilot credits tied to usage milestones

Thanks, Rishi and Jordan — this looks good. A few quick confirmations:  

- Lumos legal is fine with a short amendment (please send).
- We will complete the security checklist by Monday (SSO + IP allowlist).
- Raj will be the technical point for validation (raj@lumosai.com).

Can you include a clause that states unused credits expire 120 days after issuance? That helps our finance team match revenue timing. Otherwise the tranche timing and validation criteria look fine.

If you send the DocuSign today we’ll sign and get the checklist back early next week so Jordan’s dashboard verification can start. Looking forward to the pilot.

Best,
Elena

---
Elena Torres
Head of Product | LumosAI
elena@lumosai.com
